errors.text_span: обналожни етикети през всеки един годишен интервал
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the labels are placed at every single yearly interval; they appear instead for every year from 2013 to 2022.
The description states the line for France has a 'grey-grey' color, while it should correctly specify a single light grey line.
The description does not mention the y-axis minor ticks or intervals between the range values.
The description does not mention the lack of markers or the visual emphasis of certain lines' peaks or troughs.
The term 'готика' appears out of context and may confuse the reader.
